titulo_original: Mr. Nelson, Did You Kill People?

sinopsis.es: El cineasta japonés de culto Shinya Tsukamoto dirige al aclamado actor de Broadway Rodney Hicks y al ganador del Oscar Geoffrey Rush en un retrato desgarrador, visceral y moralmente urgente del veterano de Vietnam Allen Nelson.
sinopsis.en: Cult Japanese filmmaker Shinya Tsukamoto directs acclaimed Broadway actor Rodney Hicks and Oscar winner Geoffrey Rush in a harrowing, visceral, and morally urgent portrait of Vietnam veteran Allen Nelson.
